changes.comment: Fix getCurrentFields returning a detached snapshot instead of the control's live field record. It delegated to existingFields, which yields a throwaway {} while _fields is still undefined, so a caller that captured the record before any field was materialized held an object the engine never wrote to. Legacy went through _logic.ensureObject()._fields, which forced the record into existence; getCurrentFields now materializes it the same way. This is what @astroapps/forms-core's createOverrideProxy relies on — without it every nested scripted override (displayData.text, renderOptions.overrideText, groupOptions.columns) silently stopped applying.
